scope.summary: Implement the per-profile UV strategy per Section 13.26 (GREQ-010/031, PREQ-027): UDIM tile passthrough for offline-render profiles versus single-tile 0-1 atlas repack with material merge for game profiles, preserving genital/areola hero texel-density priority through the repack.
acceptance_criteria: Offline profiles (blender_gltf offline intent, usd) pass the UDIM tile layout (head/torso/limbs/genitals) through unchanged; game profiles repack all charts into a single 0-1 atlas.
Atlas repack merges materials to the profile's target count (1-2 draw-call-friendly materials, GREQ-031) and rebakes all texture sets into the new layout.
Texel-density priority survives the repack: genital and areola charts retain their hero px/cm ratio relative to body charts within tolerance (PREQ-027 as a measured check).
UV validation runs post-repack: no chart overlaps, no charts outside 0-1, padding respected; results feed the export validation report.
scope.risk_if_missed: Game exports keep UDIMs no engine wants, or the repack downsamples exactly the closeup regions (genitals, areolas) that carry the product's arousal payload.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
